name: Relentless 64
summary: Relentless 64 is built around relentless speed and pure score chasing, with enemy waves flowing continuously into one another. Clearing entire formations increases your score multiplier, but a single mistake instantly resets it. There are no breaks and no end-of-level pauses, just seamless transitions and constant forward momentum that demand total focus. With no power-ups or bosses, the appeal comes entirely from raw horizontal shooting action, blistering pace, and the constant risk of losing your hard-earned scoring chain.
